test_PathManager_open: test the PathManager open method to read a local file using the unified file I/O interface
test_PathManager_exists_isfile_isdir: test the PathManager exists, isfile, and isdir methods to check file and directory presence
test_PathManager_copy_mv_rm: test the PathManager copy, move, and remove methods for file operations across different storage backends
test_HTTPURLHandler_get_local_path: test the HTTPURLHandler to download a remote HTTP URL and cache it locally via get_local_path
test_LazyPath_materialize: test the LazyPath class to lazily evaluate a path function only when the path is first accessed
